Park in the lot on Woodrow Street. Our address is 911 Evans Street which is the front of the building. The lot is on the backside of the building.
For the Hub Shop, turn right after entering and take the elevator up to the 4th floor.
cincinnati-recycling-reuse-hub.cognitive: For general plastics recycling, visit the Customer Service desk in the rear of the facility and check in with your Hub Club membership or purchase a 30-day pass . For electronics and universal waste, visit the E-Waste Plus area to the left.

Beginning in January 2026, customers will check in at either the Welcome Desk at the front of the Hub Club, or at Customer Service in the rear. You can check in with the QR code, phone number, or email address associated with your account.
cincinnati-recycling-reuse-hub.chronic.1: Customers do not need a membership to drop off reusable items.
Simply go to our Customer Service desk in the rear of the Hub Club to drop off these items with a Hub staff member or volunteer.
Is a membership required to shop at the Hub Shop? No, the Hub Shop is absolutely free to all visitors. Simply head to the right when you enter the Hub Club and take the elevator up to the 4th floor.
These items will be donated to local nonprofits or sold in our 4th floor Hub Shop
cincinnati-recycling-reuse-hub.chronic.2: Review our list of what we take, and pre-sort items as much as possible.
Be sure that all items are CLEAN and DRY.
Place your items into their respective bins. ( See map here .) Volunteers will help you if you have questions!
